1.title: AGAUR Joan Oró FI — Catalan predoctoral grant
1.source: AGAUR Joan Oró FI — Catalan predoctoral grant
1.eligibility_notes: THE Catalan predoc grant (formerly FI, now 'Joan Oró FI'). 3-year contract, requires enrolment in a Catalan doctoral programme. Direct regional fit if you do your PhD at UAB/UB/UPF/CREAF etc. Official trámit: tramits.gencat.cat (search 'Joan Oró FI').
1.cadence: Annual — 2026 call closed ~30 Jan; expect next call ~Jan 2027
